name: CattailTallLean
notes: pivot at the root; stalks+leaves on Plants with wind UV2; cobs on Props carry the same wind UV2 values as their stalk (needs wind on the Props shader or cobs will not follow the swaying stalk); water_line_z is a suggested planting depth (shallow water/shore)
